question: Which kind of householder is presented as an exemplary spiritual practitioner?
premises: A householder can be spiritually accomplished.
Devotion to the liṅga and wisdom characterize such a person.
The verse identifies a wise householder devoted to the liṅga.
inference: The exemplary practitioner is a wise householder firmly devoted to the liṅga.
plain_english: Of the wise householder who is firmly devoted to the liṅga.
